description: Shared type definitions for Open Gaming inline attestations, single-metric score formatting, co-op participants, multi-locale translations, dimension maps, and genre breakdowns.

inlineSignature.description: An inline CID-first cryptographic attestation (compatible with the badge.blue / atproto-attestation specification). Computed over the DAG-CBOR CIDv1 of the parent record with `signatures` stripped and `$sig` injected containing `repository: <playerDid>` (and optional `rkey` when bound to a specific record key). Supports publisher signing, multi-issuer EoS federation (`issuer`), and peer-to-peer multi-participant match co-signing.

key.description: Verification method URI or DID key used to sign the attestation CID (e.g. `did:plc:gamepublisher#attestations`, `did:plc:communityhost#attestations`, `did:plc:opponent#attestations`, or `did:key:z...`).

signature.description: Normalized low-S ECDSA signature bytes over the repository-bound attestation CIDv1 bytes.

issuer.description: Optional DID of the game publisher, tournament host, community revival authority, or co-signing match participant issuing the attestation.

issuedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the signature was generated.

rkey.description: Optional record key binding. When present, verifiers ensure the record resides at this exact `rkey`, preventing a player from moving a signed payload to a new `rkey` to evade URI-targeted ATProto moderation labels.

cid.description: Optional explicit copy of the computed attestation CIDv1 (`bafy...`) that was signed.

scoreFormat.description: Formatting rules for single-value integer leaderboard scores (modeled on Google Play Games Services score formatting, compatible with ATProto's integer-only data model).

kind.description: How raw integer scores should be interpreted for display.

decimalPlaces.description: Fixed decimal point offset for `numeric` or `currency` scores. For example, raw integer `314159` with `decimalPlaces: 2` displays as `3,141.59`.

timeUnit.description: Base integer unit for `time` leaderboards. For example, `66032` with `milliseconds` displays as `1:06.03`.

unitSingular.description: Optional custom singular unit label for `numeric` scores (e.g. `meter`, `pipe`, `like`, `pt`).

unitPlural.description: Optional custom plural unit label for `numeric` scores (e.g. `meters`, `pipes`, `likes`, `pts`).

signedPrefix.description: When true, positive values render with an explicit leading `+` (e.g. `+3` vs `-4` for golf-style par scores or rating deltas).

option.description: A named categorical option used in `leaderboard.definition#enum` components or `leaderboard.definition#dimension` sub-board variables.

id.description: Stable machine identifier for this option (e.g. `all-perfect`, `full-combo`, `4k`, `keyboard`, `glitchless`).

participant.description: A player or local couch co-op guest credited in a multiplayer co-op, duo, squad, or raid run (`leaderboard.score` or `achievement.unlock`).

did.description: AT Protocol DID of the participant. Optional so couch co-op guests without an ATProto account can still be credited by `name`.

name.description: Optional display name or guest handle at the time of the run.

role.description: Optional class, seat, or role played during the run (e.g. `healer`, `pilot`, `player-2`, `left-pad`).

stringMap.description: Forward-compatible Lexicon `map` of `record-key` keys (`1..32` chars) to string values (`<= 256` chars), used for sub-board `dimensions` (e.g. `{ "mode": "4k", "inputMethod": "keyboard" }`) and custom key-value attributes.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

translation.description: Localized display text fields for an achievement, leaderboard, or challenge definition in a specific BCP-47 language.

name.description: Localized leaderboard name (or romanized song title, e.g. under `ja-Latn`).

translationMap.description: Optional dictionary map of BCP-47 language tags (e.g. `ja`, `ja-Latn`, `ko`, `zh-Hans`, `es`) to localized `#translation` strings. Keeps primary `title`/`name`/`description` as plain strings for zero-boilerplate indie/jam DX while enabling full global localization.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

unlockContext.description: Standardized RPG Hall-of-Fame, roguelike victory, cozy catch/build, or narrative clear snapshot attachable via `achievement.unlock#details`.

summary.description: Short commemorative summary generated by the game (e.g. `Cleared Ascension 20 with Silent · Shiv Deck`).

playtimeMs.description: Elapsed campaign or run playtime in milliseconds when the achievement was earned.

loadout.description: Optional list of party members, creatures, jokers, relics, or equipment used (e.g. Pokémon Hall-of-Fame party or Balatro Joker lineup).

judgmentEntry.description: Timing judgment count for a single judgment window (e.g. `marvelous`, `perfect`, `great`, `good`, `miss`) in a rhythm or precision action game.

judgmentMap.description: Dictionary map of timing judgment key (`record-key` format, e.g. `marvelous`, `perfect`, `great`, `good`, `miss`) to `#judgmentEntry` counts, using the forward-compatible `$keyFormat`/`$valueType` Lexicon `map` convention.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

judgmentBreakdown.description: Standardized Lexicon v1 judgment & input breakdown for rhythm/arcade runs (inspired by `dev.tsunagite.score`), attachable via `leaderboard.score#details`.

judgmentOrder.description: Optional explicit display order of judgment keys in `judgments` (e.g. `["marvelous", "perfect", "great", "miss"]`), preserving author-intended order across DAG-CBOR canonical map-key sorting.
